                        ( p. 539 ) S دهانشك धानुष्क dhānushk (fr. dhanus ), s.m. A bowman, an archer ( = dhānuk , q.v.). 2) دهانشکا dhānushkā
                        ( p. 539 ) S دهانشکا धानुष्का dhānushkā , s.f. The plant Achyranthes aspera . 3) دهنش dhanush
                        ( p. 548 ) S دهنش धनुष् dhanush (for dhanus , q.v.; but used in Hindī both in comp. and alone), s.m. A bow; rainbow, &c. ( = dhanuk ): — dhanush-pāṇī (or pānī ), adj. & s.m. Armed with a bow; — an archer: — dhanush-paṭ , s.m. The tree Buchanania latifolia : — dhanush toṛnā , To fire off a bow: — dhanush-ṭaṅkār , s.m. Twang of a bow; — a severe spasmodic affection: — dhanush ṭūṭnā , A bow to go off: — dhanush-dhār = dhanuk-dhar , q.v.s.v. dhanuk : — dhanush-dhārā = dhanuk-dharā , q.v.: — dhanush-dhārī , s.m. = dhanur-dhārī , q.v.s.v. dhanus : — dhanush-dhar , adj. & s.m. = dhanur-dhar , q.v.s.v. dhanus : — dhanush-kshetr , s.m. Segment of a circle: — dhanush-koṭi , s.f. Point or end of a bow: — dhanush-mān , dhanush-mant , adj. & s.m. (f. matī ), Having a bow; — an archer, bowman: — dhanush-vāṇ , vulg. dhanush-bān , s.m. Bow and arrow: — dhanush-vān , adj. & s.m. = dhanush-mān , q.v.: — dhanush-vidyā , s.m. The science of archery: — dhanush-yajna , s.m. Any religious ceremony in which the bow figures as an emblem.                         ( p. 126 ) H بان बान bān [S. वर्णः ; Prk. वण्मो ], s.f. Quality, property, temper, disposition, nature, character, conduct, manners, habit, custom (cf. ān-bān , s.v. ān ); — s.m. The marriage rite which prescribes a certain number of baths (generally from three to eleven) for the bride and bridegroom: — bān baiṭhnā , v.n. To take the baths prescribed by the marriage rite (mentioned above): — bān paṛnā , v.n. To fall into, or to acquire or form, a habit, &c. to be trained; to be accustomed (to): — bān ḍālnā , v.n. To lay the foundation of character, &c., cultivate a habit, &c. to educate, train; to habituate, accustom, inure; to naturalize: — bān sīkhnā , v.n. = bān paṛnā . 2) بان bān
                        ( p. 126 ) H بان बान bān [S. वाण ], s.m. Reed-shaft, arrow, dart; rocket (for battle), sky-rocket; — the bloody track of a wounded animal; — name of an Asur (son of Rājā Bali , an enemy of Vishṇu ): — bān-āsur ( vāṇa + asura ), s.m. Bān the Asur: — bān-dār , bān-wālā , s.m. Bowman, archer; rocketeer: — bān-kosh , s.m. Quiver. 3) بان bān
                        ( p. 126 ) H بان बान bān [S. वान , rt. वा ], s.m. The high tidal wave in Indian rivers commonly called 'the Bore.' 4) بان bān
                        ( p. 126 ) H بان बान bān [S. वान and वाण , rt. वे ], s.m. Rope made of twisted grass ( ḍāb ), or of mūṅj (used for the bottom of beds as well as for other purposes). 5) بان bān
                        ( p. 126 ) P H بان बान bān [S. suff. वान् ; वत् ], A suffix signifying 'keeper,' 'man,' &c. (e.g. dar-bān , 'door-keeper'; gāṛī-bān , 'cart-man'; bāg̠-bān , 'garden-er.' The suffix is also written wān ). 6) بان bān
                        ( p. 126 ) A بان bān , s.m. The ben -tree, Hyperanthera moringa (syn. sahajnā ); — the tree Melia sempervirens (syn. bakāʼin ); — the tree which yields Benzoin or Benjamin, Styrax benzoin ; — a species of willow, Salix Ӕgyptia (Pers. syn. bed-mushk ). 7) بان bāṅ
                        ( p. 126 ) H بان बां bāṅ , s.f. 1˚ = bāṅh ; 2˚ adj. = bām , q.q.v. 8) بانا bānā
                        ( p. 126 ) H بانا बाना bānā [S. वान , rt. वे + कः ], s.m. The woof (as opp. to tānā , 'warp'); a silken thread used in weaving and sewing, &c. a kind of hemispherical bucket made of iron plates closely riveted together, used in raising water for irrigation. 9) بانا bānā
                        ( p. 126 ) H بانا बाना bānā [S. वाण , rt. वण् + कः ], s.m. A kind of rocket; a kind of sword, a sort of paṭṭā with a thick-edged blade and a wooden hilt: — bānā bāṅdhnā , v.n. To be armed; to be ready; to be determined: — bānā-wālā , s.m. Rocket-thrower (cf. bān-dār ). 10) بانا bānā
                        ( p. 126 ) H بانا बाना bānā [S. पाण + कः ], s.m. Stake, bet, wager: — bānā bāṅdhnā , v.n. To stake, bet, wager (syn. budnā ). 11) بانا bānā
                        ( p. 126 ) H بانا बाना bānā [S. वर्ण + कः ; Prk. वण्मको ], s.m. Appearance, form, shape, colour; property, habit, peculiarity; profession, caste, sect, class; veil, covering; dress, garment, costume, fashion or style of dress; uniform, livery; mask, disguise: — bānā badalnā , v.n. To change (one's) dress; to disguise oneself (syn. bhes badalnā ). 12) بانا bānā
                        ( p. 126 ) H بانا बाना bānā [S. वहन , rt. वह ; cf. bāhnā , v.n. To open, unfold, streten, spread; to cast; — v.n. To open ( = khulnā ); to burst open, split ( = phaṭnā ). 13) بانات bānāt, banāt
                        ( p. 126 ) H بانات बानात bānāt , vulg. banāt (cf. bānā , 'woof'), s.f. Broad-cloth. 14) باناتي bānātī, bannātī
                        ( p. 126 ) H باناتي बानाती bānātī , vulg. bannātī , adj. Made of broad-cloth; woollen. 15) بانان bāṅāṅ
                        ( p. 126 ) H بانان बांआं bāṅāṅ , adj. Left (hand) = bāmā , bāṅwāṅ , bāyāṅ , q.q.v. 16) بانب bāṅb, bāmb
                        ( p. 126 ) H بانب बांब bāṅb , improp. बाम्ब bāmb [S. वाम ; but cf. bāṅbī ], s.f.m. (?), Snake; eel ( = bām , q.v.): — bāṅt andhūʼā , s.m. Eel. 17) بان بان bāṅ-bāṅ
                        ( p. 126 ) H بان بان बांबां bāṅ-bāṅ , s.f. Prating, jabber, senseless talk: — bāṅ-bāṅ karnā , To prate, talk foolishly, &c. to blurt out (a secret, &c.); to make a disagreeable noise, bellow, howl. 18) بانبهني bāṅbhnī
                        ( p. 126 ) H بانبهني बांभनी bāṅbhnī , = H بانبهي बांभी bāṅbhī , बांभई bāṅbhaʼī , = H بانبي बांबी bāṅbī , बांबई bāṅbaʼī , [S. वल्मीक ; — cf. S. वाम , and H. bām and bāṅb ], s.f. Hillock or ground thrown up by white ants, ant-hill; snake's hole (since ant-hills deserted by ants are commonly taken possession of by snakes). 19) بانبهي bāṅbhī, bāṅbhaʼī
                        ( p. 126 ) H بانبهي बांभी bāṅbhī , बांभई bāṅbhaʼī , = H بانبهني बांभनी bāṅbhnī , = H بانبي बांबी bāṅbī , बांबई bāṅbaʼī , [S. वल्मीक ; — cf. S. वाम , and H. bām and bāṅb ], s.f. Hillock or ground thrown up by white ants, ant-hill; snake's hole (since ant-hills deserted by ants are commonly taken possession of by snakes). 20) بانبي bāṅbī, bāṅbaʼī
                        ( p. 126 ) H بانبي बांबी bāṅbī , बांबई bāṅbaʼī , = H بانبهني बांभनी bāṅbhnī , = H بانبهي बांभी bāṅbhī , बांभई bāṅbhaʼī , [S. वल्मीक ; — cf. S. वाम , and H. bām and bāṅb ], s.f. Hillock or ground thrown up by white ants, ant-hill; snake's hole (since ant-hills deserted by ants are commonly taken possession of by snakes). 21) بان پرستهہ bāna-prasth
                        ( p. 126 ) H بان پرستهہ बानप्रस्थ bāna-prasth [S. वान + प्रस्थ ], s.m. A Brāhmaṇ of the third order who has passed through the stages of student and householder and has left his house and family for the woods (syn. āsram ); hermit, anchorite. 22) بانٿ bāṅṭ
                        ( p. 126 ) H بانٿ बांट bāṅṭ , s.m. = bāṭ , 'a weight,' &c. q.v. 23) بانٿ bāṅṭ
                        ( p. 126 ) H بانٿ बांट bāṅṭ [S. वण्ट , rt. वण्ट् ], s.m.f. Dividing, apportioning; division, distribution (syn. taqsīm ); part, portion, share, allotment; dealing, deal (at cards); lot, concern, business; — food given to a cow while milking her: — bāṅṭ-baṭāʼū , s.m. Apportioner, distributer = bāṅṭū ; (in Arith.) denominator (syn. nasab-numā ): — bāṅṭ-būṅṭ , s.f. = bāṅṭ-ćūṅṭ , q.v.: — bāṅṭ-patra , s.m. Deed or record of division of property (syn. taqsīm-nāma ): — bāṅṭ-phal , s.m. (in Arith.), Quotient (syn. ḵẖārij-qismat , and labdhi ): — bāṅṭ-ćūṅṭ , s.m.f. Distribution, share, &c. = bāṅt , q.v. 24) بانٿا bāṅṭā
                        ( p. 126 ) H بانٿا बांटा bāṅṭā [S. वण्टकः ], s.m. Dividing, &c. share, portion, &c. = bāṅṭ , q.v.; — tying up the crops into bundles and sheaves. 25) بانٿا bāṅṭā
                        ( p. 126 ) H بانٿا बांटा bāṅṭā (part of next, q.v.), adj. Divided, apportioned, &c.: — bāṅṭā-huʼā , adj. = bāṅṭā ; — s.m. (in Arith.), Dividend (also baṭā-huʼā , syn. bhājya , and maqsūm ). 26) بانٿنا bāṅṭnā
                        ( p. 126 ) H بانٿنا बांटना bāṅṭnā [S. वण्टनीयं ], v.t. To divide, apportion, distribute, portion out, parcel out, divide into shares; to dispense, dispose of, assign; to participate, go shares in: — bāṅṭ denā , v.t. To divide, portion out (for, or in the name of, - par ), &c. = bāṅṭnā , q.v.: — bāṅṭ lenā , v.t. To participate, go shares in, &c. 27) بانٿنا bāṅṭnā
                        ( p. 126 ) H بانٿنا बांटना bāṅṭnā (caus. of baṭnā , q.v.), v.t. To twist, twine. 28) بانٿو bāṅṭū
                        ( p. 126 ) H بانٿو बांटू bāṅṭū [S. वण्ट + उक ], s.m. Divider, apportioner, &c. (in Arith.), divisor (syn. bhājak , and maqsūm-ilaih ). 29) بانٿهنا bāṅṭhnā
                        ( p. 126 ) H بانٿهنا बांठना bāṅṭhnā , v.t. = bāṅṭnā , 'to divide,' &c. 30) بانج bāṅj
                        ( p. 126 ) H بانج बांज bāṅj , adj. Barren, &c. = bānjh , q.v. 31) بانجر bānjar
                        ( p. 126 ) H بانجر बांजर bānjar , adj. Waste or fallow (land); — see banjar . 32) بانجهہ bāṅjh
                        ( p. 126 ) H بانجهہ बांझ bāṅjh [S. बंध्या ], adj. Barren (woman); unproductive, sterile (soil). 33) بانجهہ bāṅjh, bāṅj, banji
                        ( p. 126 ) H بانجهہ बांझ bāṅjh , bāṅj , banji [S. वन + ज , or वन + राजि ], s.m. The tree Quercus incana , or dilatata (common in the outer Himalaya, the acorns of which are commonly made into necklaces for children, and are regarded as a charm against evil spirits). 34) بانجيه bāṇijya
                        ( p. 126 ) S بانجيه बाणिज्य bāṇijya , s.m. Trade, commerce, merchandise, traffic ( = banij , q.v.). 35) بانچکا bāṅćakā
                        ( p. 126 ) H بانچکا बांचका bāṅćakā , s.f. Reading, elocution (see next). 36) بانچنا bāṅćnā
                        ( p. 126 ) H بانچنا बांचना bāṅćnā [ bāṅć˚ = Prk. वच्च ( इ ), fr. S. वाच्य ], v.t. To read; to study; to decipher, make out. 37) بانچنا bāṅćnā
                        ( p. 126 ) H بانچنا बांचना bāṅćnā (caus. of baćnā , q.v.), v.t. To pass over, overlook, disregard, neglect; — also (prov.) = baćnā , q.v. 38) بانچها bāṅćhā
                        ( p. 126 ) H بانچها बांछा bāṅćhā [S. वाञ्छा ], s.f. Wish, desire. 39) بانچهت bāṅćhit, bāṅćhat
                        ( p. 126 ) H بانچهت बांछित bāṅćhit , bāṅćhat [S. वाञ्छित ], part. adj. Wished for, desired, longed for. 40) باچهنا bāṅćhnā
                        ( p. 126 ) H باچهنا बांछना bāṅćhnā [Prk. वांछणअं = S. वाञ्छनीय , rt. वाञ्छ् ], v.n. To wish (for), to desire. 41) باندا bāṅdā
                        ( p. 126 ) H باندا बान्दा bāṅdā , s.m. Name of a place in Bundelkhand. 42) باندا bāṅdā
                        ( p. 127 ) H باندا बांदा bāṅdā [S. वन्दा ], s.m. The parasitical plant Epidendrum tesselatum ; a parasitical plant (syn. ākāś-vela ). 43) باندر bāṅdar
                        ( p. 127 ) H باندر बांदर bāṅdar , = H باندرا बांदरा bāṅdrā , s.m. = bandar , q.v. 44) باندرا bāṅdrā
                        ( p. 127 ) H باندرا बांदरा bāṅdrā , = H باندر बांदर bāṅdar , s.m. = bandar , q.v. 45) باندرني bāṅdarnī
                        ( p. 127 ) H باندرني बांदरनी bāṅdarnī , = H باندري बांदरी bāṅdrī , s.f. (of bāṅdar ) = bandarī , q.v. 46) باندري bāṅdrī
                        ( p. 127 ) H باندري बांदरी bāṅdrī , = H باندرني बांदरनी bāṅdarnī , s.f. (of bāṅdar ) = bandarī , q.v. 47) باندنا bāṅdnā
                        ( p. 127 ) H باندنا बांदना bāṅdnā , v.t. = bāṅdhnā , q.v. 48) باندهہ bāṅdh
                        ( p. 127 ) H باندهہ बांध bāṅdh (see bāndhnā ), s.m. Fastening; tie, fetter; confinement, imprisonment; embankment; dam. 49) باندهب bāndhab
                        ( p. 127 ) H باندهب बांधब bāndhab , s.m. = bāndhav , q.v. 50) باندهلگوتي bāṅdhal-gotī
                        ( p. 127 ) H باندهلگوتي बांधलगोती bāṅdhal-gotī , s.m. Name of a tribe inhabiting a part of Bundelkhand. 51) باندهنا bāṅdhnā
                        ( p. 127 ) H باندهنا बांधना bāṅdhnā [ bāṅdh˚ = Prk. बंध ( इ ) = S. बध्ना ( ति ), rt. बन्ध् ], v.t. To bind, tie, fix, fasten; to tie up, tighten; to bind up, dress (hair, &c.); to fasten or tie (on or round), bind (round), put (on, - par ; e.g. ghāʼo-par pulṭis bāṅdho ); to chain, enchain, fetter; to take captive, enthral, captivate, bring under (one's) influence; to shut up, confine, imprison; to fix, direct, fasten (hope, eyes, aim, &c. upon, - par ); to shut, close, stop (water, &c.), to embank; to arrest, hold back, check; to bind together, join together (in marriage, &c.), fasten together, put together, join, connect, conglomerate, unite, gather, pack, set (e.g. gathrī bāṅdhnā ; haḍḍī bāṅdhnā ; hāth bāṅdhnā ; laḍḍū bāṅdhnā ; maẓmūn bāṅdhnā ); to build, construct (dam, bridge, &c.); to compose (verses); to form, produce, make, constitute (e.g. ṣaf bāṅdhnā ; nīyat bāṅdhnā ; samā bāṅdhnā ); to entertain, cherish, foster, have, contract, form (enmity, friendship, &c.); to put on, lay on, impose, levy (e.g. maḥsūl bāṅdhnā ); to put on, lay (a stake, wager, &c.); to fix, erect, set up (a post, standard, &c.); to devise, contrive, plan; to make (of, - ko ), constitute, regard as, compare to (e.g. tū usko tār bāṅdh , 'you regard her as, or liken her to, a palm'): — bāṅdh-denā , v.t. = bāṅdhnā : — bāṅdh lenā , v.t. (intens. of bāṅdhnā ), To bind up, tie up, &c. 52) باندهنو bāṅdhnū
                        ( p. 127 ) H باندهنو बांधनू bāṅdhnū , s.m. Invention, fabrication; slander, calumny; plan, plot; story, fiction, romance; a mode of dying in which the cloth is tied up in different places to prevent the parts tied from receiving the dye; a checked or spotted cloth; a kind of coloured silk (syn. gul-badan ); a species of parrot: — bāṅdhnū bāṅdhnā , v.n. To invent, fabricate. 53) باندهو bāndhav
                        ( p. 127 ) S باندهو बान्धव bāndhav , s.m. Relation, relative, kinsman, friend. 54) باندي bāṅdī
                        ( p. 127 ) H باندي बांदी bāṅdī [S. वन्दी or बन्दी ], s.f. A female slave, bondmaid (syn. launḍī ): — bāṅdī-baććā , bāṅdī-kā beṭā or janā , s.m. lit . 'Son of a bondmaid'; an obedient or submissive person. 55) بانڐا bāṅḍā
                        ( p. 127 ) H بانڐا बांडा bāṅḍā [S. वण्ड + कः ], adj. & s.m. Maimed, crippled; docked; tailless; — a tailless bird; a tailless snake; a man who has been circumcised (applied as a term of abuse to Musalmans, especially in Bengal). 56) بانڐي bāṅdī
                        ( p. 127 ) H بانڐي बांदी bāṅdī (dim. of bāṅḍā ), s.f. A short thick stick, cudgel, club; a kind of dress: — bāṅḍī-bāz , s.m. Cudgeller; clubman, one who carries and uses a club: — bāṅḍī ćaṭaknā , bāṅḍī ćalnā , v.n. Clubs to be set a-going; a fight with clubs taking place. 57) بانر bānar
                        ( p. 127 ) H بانر बानर bānar [S. वानर ], s.m. Monkey = bandar , q.v. 58) بانس bāṅs
                        ( p. 127 ) H بانس बांस bāṅs [S. वंश ], s.m. The bamboo, Bambusa arundinacea and stricta ; a bamboo or rod, about ten feet long, used in measuring land, &c.: — bāṅs-par ṭāṅgnā , bāṅs-par ćaṛhānā , v.t. To stick or raise up on a bamboo; ( fig. ) to hold up to ridicule, infamy, &c., to disgrace: — bāṅs-par ćaṛhnā , v.n. To climb up a bamboo; to be stuck up on a bamboo; to be held up to ridicule, infamy, &c., to be branded with infamy: — bāṅs-phoṛ (S. vaṅśa + sphoṭa ), s.m. lit . 'Bamboo-splitter'; a caste who engage in bamboo-work, manufacturing baskets, &c. out of split bamboos (syn. basoṛ , ćohāṛ , ḍom ): — bāṅsoṅ ućhalnā , bāṅsoṅ kūdnā , v.n. To leap or bound for joy, to rejoice. 59) بانشا bāṅsā
                        ( p. 127 ) H بانشا बांसा bāṅsā [S. वंश + कः ], s.m. Bridge of the nose; back-bone, spine (syn. rīṛh ); the bamboo tube through which the seed descends in a drilling machine; a drill-plough; — a plant of the bamboo species (a variety of the Dendrocalamus Tulda or pekā-bāṅs ) from which a red dye is extracted (syn. piyā-bāṅsā ). 60) بانسري bāṅsrī, bāṅsurī
                        ( p. 127 ) H بانسري बांसरी bāṅsrī , बांसुरी bāṅsurī [S. वंश + र + इका ], s.f. Pipe, fife, flute, flageolet: — bāṅsrī bajānā , v.n. To pipe, to play on the flute. 61) بانسري bāṅsarī
                        ( p. 127 ) H بانسري बांसरी bāṅsarī , s.f. A weed (found in the Doāb ), which is very injurious, and most difficult to eradicate. 62) بانسلي bāṅslī
                        ( p. 127 ) H بانسلي बांसली bāṅslī , s.f. Flute, &c. = bāṅsrī , q.v.; — a purse ( = bāṅsnī ). 63) بانسني bāṅsnī
                        ( p. 127 ) H بانسني बांसनी bāṅsnī [S. वासनी ], s.f. A purse ( = basnī , q.v.). 64) بانسواڙي bāṅs-wāṛī
